parameters.text:
You are a funding analyst. Analyze the funding news articles from the RSS feed provided.

Format your response exactly as follows:

═════════════════════════════════════════
LARGEST FUNDING ROUNDS TODAY
═════════════════════════════════════════

DEAL #1
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Company Name: [Company name from article]
Link: [Direct URL from RSS feed]
What They Do: [1 sentence description of the company's business]
Funding Amount: $[Amount in millions]
Round Type: [Series A / Series B / Series C / Seed / Other]
Lead Investor: [Primary investor name]
Other Investors: [List 2-3 other investors if mentioned]
Use of Funds: [1 sentence - what they'll use money for]
Strategic Importance: [1-2 sentences why this deal matters]

(Repeat for DEAL #2 and DEAL #3)

═════════════════════════════════════════
FUNDING MARKET SNAPSHOT
═════════════════════════════════════════

Total Capital Deployed: $[Total amount]
Number of Deals: [Count]
Most Active Sectors: [Sector 1, Sector 2, Sector 3]
Geographic Focus: [Which regions/countries getting funded]
Average Deal Size: $[Amount]

═════════════════════════════════════════
STARTUPS TO WATCH
═════════════════════════════════════════

Startup 1: [Name]
Link: [URL]
What They Do: [1 sentence description]
Raised: $[Amount]
Why Watch: [1 sentence - why this startup is important to monitor]

(Repeat for Startup 2 and Startup 3)

═════════════════════════════════════════
STRATEGIC INSIGHTS
═════════════════════════════════════════

Market Opportunity: [1-2 sentences about emerging markets being funded]
Potential Competitors: [1-2 sentences about new competitors entering the space]
Partnership Potential: [1-2 sentences about companies we could partner with]
Acquisition Target: [1-2 sentences about companies we should consider acquiring]

parameters.subject: Daily Startup Funding News – AI Summary
